subject: ACE activation runway & PDM/PSM intros — Amplitude marketplace listing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@amplitude.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACE activation runway & PDM/PSM intros — Amplitude marketplace listing

Hi Sofia — great to connect at re:Invent follow-up last week. Picking up from our brief chat: Redwood would like to move forward with ACE registration for the Amplitude marketplace and coordinate a short co-sell kickoff so our PDM/PSM teams can align on account motion and technical readiness.

Top asks to get the ACE process moving:
- Confirm the ACE intake form owner and a preferred contact for the marketplace metadata (icons, product description, tech category).
- Quick intro to the Amplitude PDM/PSM who will be on the co-sell for this opportunity (we propose a 30–45 minute sync).
- Any timeline constraints for listing in the marketplace (target window we should aim for).

I've attached a draft ACE registration PDF and a short marketplace metadata checklist — these are rough so we can iterate.

Proposed next steps if that works for you:
1) You share the PDM/PSM contacts and intake owner.
2) We schedule a 30-min kickoff (agenda: intake, mutual action plan, technical checklist).
3) Draft listing metadata exchanged in Drive and reviewed within 5 business days.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on times.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0162

Attachments: redwood-ace-registration-draft.pdf (application form stub), marketplace-metadata-draft.md (doc stub)

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@amplitude.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@amplitude.com
Date: 2028-05-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE activation runway & PDM/PSM intros — Amplitude marketplace listing

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and for sending the draft materials. Happy to help — tagging partnerships so they can route to the right product team.

PDM/PSM assignment: I'll get a PDM (Elena V.) and a PSM (Marcus G.) on the thread by EOD. Our intake owner for marketplace metadata is partners@amplitude.com (they will share the listing template).

Timeline: our next marketplace sprint is the week of June 12, so if we can finalize metadata and ACE intake by June 5 that would put you in the queue for the June sprint.

A couple of initial questions for your engineering partner:
- Do you have a public listing for a marketplace offering already, or will this be a new listing?
- Any specific AWS integration notes (e.g., marketplace entitlements, 1-click AMI vs API-only) we should be aware of?

I'll be back with contacts shortly.

—Sofia
Director, Partnerships — Amplitude
sofia.martinez@amplitude.com

Jordan / team — thanks for looping me in. Quick notes from GTM and marketplace ops side:
- This will be a new listing for Redwood (we currently don't have an Amplitude 'product' in their marketplace).
- For ACE registration, ideal to have completed intake + marketplace metadata at least one week before their sprint cutoff (so Sofia's June 5 target is reasonable).

I'm adding a very small checklist below to prepare internal owners before the kickoff:
1) Legal: pricing model and whether we'll use marketplace-managed billing (need pricing SKU decision).
2) Security: SOC2 scope summary + contact (we'll include our compliance pack).
3) Engineering: quick doc on how our product is consumed (API endpoints, auth model, network egress).
4) Sales: mutually agreed TAM and top 10 target accounts for co-sell motion.

I'll pull together the compliance pack and the pricing SKU options and drop them in the Drive link you included.

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: ACE activation runway & PDM/PSM intros — Amplitude marketplace listing

Adding a technical perspective — copying the short answers Sofia asked for so her team has visibility: 
- This is a new listing: yes, packaging will be "API-first" (no AMI required).
- Integration notes: OAuth2 token-based auth, optional VPC peering for enterprise customers. No marketplace-managed entitlements required at launch; we'll support an API-key flow tied to customer accounts.

I'll prepare a 1-page tech summary (endpoints, auth, expected throughput, and typical latency) and upload it to the Drive folder. Also happy to join the initial kickoff call to answer any integration questions.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
